summary: Genmab A/S filed a Form 6-K disclosing a routine employee equity award: the board granted 13,794 restricted stock units and 13,331 warrants to employees of the company and subsidiaries, effective September 24, 2026. Each RSU is cost-free with a DKK 2,268 fair value (closing price that day); warrants carry a DKK 2,268 exercise price, a Black-Scholes value of DKK 781.96, three-year vesting and seven-year expiry, under programs dating to 2021. No stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation or deal terms; this is ordinary compensation disclosure, not a special situation.
